pages.text: A tiny cucumber grew in a corner of the garden. Weeds poked up all around it. Momo sat in the furrow.
"I'll pick and eat this cucumber." Yuki glanced at the weeds. "I'll pull them tomorrow."
The next day, Yuki went to the cool stream. "I'll pull the weeds later."
The day after, a shower came. Yuki watched from the porch. "How can I pull weeds in the rain?"
Momo went into the garden. The weeds hid everything but a wagging tail.
Yuki visited the garden. The weeds reached their waist.
Parting the grass revealed the cucumber, small and crooked. "Why didn't it grow?"
Grandma looked at the weeds. "Yesterday, they came to your knees, didn't they?" Yuki touched their knees.
From that day, Yuki pulled a handful of weeds every morning. A pile grew in a yard corner. "Today's are all done!"
The cucumber grew as big as Yuki's palm. Yuki picked it and took a crunchy bite.
